findings.claim: Explicit reliance on an unseen source still passes. Quote matching, shared vocabulary, two-reader agreement and replay do not establish that the quoted context supports the answer. Declaring this residual does not satisfy the rule that NI remains without context.
findings.guidance_basis: C3 excludes memory and outside sources. Contextual probability requires reasonable support from the trial circumstances, not merely a matching quotation: [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: 1.2=PY; sole source/quote='Randomisation details were omitted.'; rationale='Randomisation was concealed according to the original manuscript.' -> NI. Currently verifies as PY, including when both readers supply it.

findings.claim: The 4.3 topic gate rejects valid contextual inference for participant-reported outcomes. Restricting setting-based reasoning to four questions is not guidance-faithful. The earlier out-of-A2 decline leaves this rule defect unresolved.
findings.guidance_basis: Participants are the assessors for participant-reported outcomes; awareness can follow from distinguishable interventions. [RoB 2 guidance, §7.1 and Table 11](https://facenteconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/20190822_RoB_2.0_guidance_parallel_trial.pdf).
findings.failing_test: Asked 4.3=NI; quote='Participants received surgery or physiotherapy and reported their pain.'; PY rationale explaining that participants distinguish these treatments and assess their own pain -> accept contextual PY. Currently returns NI because the quote lacks a listed stem.

findings.claim: An earlier matching reader call is not proof that it supplied the unread slot in this adjudication. The search can select another attempt with the same targets and evidence, falsely qualifying a genuine adjudication for supersession. Bind the proof to the original pass's reader record IDs.
findings.guidance_basis: C4 binds decisions to their actual recorded readings. Signed A2 permits superseding defect-caused adjudications, not any adjudication for which a different earlier reader record could explain the defect.
findings.failing_test: Original agy record is strict JSON with an empty answers list; its disagreement is genuine. Add an earlier, unused prose-prefixed agy PY with identical trial/outcome/targets/evidence -> defect_caused must remain False. Currently returns True.

findings.claim: Closed-branch contextual decisions remain invisible in the rendered assessment. The renderer ignores closed_contextual and contextual_audit. The A2 storage test therefore does not establish 'never silent'; deferring rendering leaves the stated display requirement unmet.
findings.guidance_basis: C5 and the user's decision require every contextual answer to be stored and shown as contextual with its quotation. Retaining data alone meets only the storage requirement.
findings.failing_test: Apply contextual PY to 3.1 and 3.3 together, closing 3.3; render the resulting object -> show 3.3's contextual decision and quote, explicitly marked as subsequently not applicable. Currently neither appears.

findings.claim: The outside-envelope regex mistakes an ordinary prose mention of a key for a malformed JSON envelope. This voids an otherwise unique, valid reading. The conservative-default decline contradicts A2's signed promise to ignore surrounding prose; no observed impact on held replies does not establish correctness.
findings.guidance_basis: SIGNING_A2.md part 1 specifies extraction of the JSON answer object with surrounding prose ignored. C4 should void an unreadable reading, not a clearly readable object solely because its introduction names a field.
findings.failing_test: 'The "answers": array follows.\n' + json.dumps(REPLY) -> REPLY. Currently returns None, causing the whole contextual pass to be voided.
